start: Signed in online; a member message and a new-member notice are waiting

steps.action: Tap the bell at the top
user_sees: A panel 'Notifications' with the groups 'Your gym', 'From MettleUp' and 'What’s new'
A payment line carries the label 'Payment'
must_not: Opening the bell marks a to-do as done
A line of another gym

steps.action: Tap the member-message line
user_sees: Its page opens; the line stays on the list until someone handles it there
must_not: The to-do vanishing just because it was opened

steps.action: Tap the X on the new-member line
user_sees: 'Removed from your list.' with 'Undo'
must_not: The line removed from another person's bell
The notice deleted from its page

start: Today open in a visible tab for more than 10 seconds

steps.action: A member sends a new message from the app
user_sees: A short ring, once
The line shows on Today under what needs you
must_not: A ring on opening the panel
A second ring for the same line on the next poll
A ring while the tab is hidden

steps.action: Handle it in its page
user_sees: It leaves Today; the bell count drops
must_not: The line still on Today after it was done

steps.action: Tap 'Turn on alerts on this device' and allow the browser's question
user_sees: 'Alerts are on for this device.' and a button 'Turn off on this device'
must_not: 'on' shown when the server did not save this device
The browser question asked again on every tap

steps.action: Under 'Send the rest' pick 'Once a day', set 'Time', tap 'Save'
user_sees: 'Saved.'
must_not: Urgent alerts also delayed to the daily time

steps.action: Close the admin app; a member places a shop order
user_sees: A notice on this device; a tap opens the right page
must_not: A notice after alerts were turned off on this device
A notice that opens the wrong page

steps.action: Tap 'Turn on alerts on this device' and block the browser's question
user_sees: 'Alerts are blocked in this browser. Allow notifications for this site in the browser settings, then come back here.'
must_not: 'Alerts are on for this device.'
A crash or an empty card

steps.action: With the internet off, tap 'Turn on alerts on this device'
user_sees: 'Alerts could not be turned on. Check the internet and try again.'
must_not: A device saved as on that will never get a notice

steps.action: Change 'Send the rest' and tap 'Save' with the internet off
user_sees: 'Not saved. Check the internet and try again.'
must_not: 'Saved.' for a choice the server never got

start: Bell open, one line removed with the X

steps.action: Tap 'Undo'
user_sees: The line is back in 'Your gym'
must_not: The line back twice

steps.action: Remove it again, then unfold 'History'
user_sees: 'The last 7 days: what was done, opened or removed. Tap a line to open it.'
The line with the tag 'Removed · Not done yet'; a finished one says 'Done by <name>'
must_not: A line older than 7 days
A removed to-do shown as 'Done'

steps.action: With nothing ever finished, unfold 'History'
user_sees: 'Nothing here yet. What you finish or remove shows here for 7 days.'
must_not: A blank fold

steps.action: Finish every to-do
user_sees: 'Nothing is waiting for you. New messages and requests from your members will show here.'
must_not: A bell number left above zero

start: Owner and one front-desk person signed in on two devices; a member sends a complaint

steps.action: Open the bell
user_sees: The complaint line, as the owner
must_not: The complaint shown to the owner late or not at all

steps.action: Tap X on a shared line
user_sees: It leaves only this person's list
must_not: The other person's bell changed by this person's X
